test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Identify the main theme of the passage.

options.text: The main theme of the passage is trusting oneself.
The main theme of the passage is to have an ambition and a desire in life.
The main theme of the passage is strong will. A person having strong will can achieve anything in life.
The main theme of the passage is to have a goal in life.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3).** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The main theme of the passage is highlighted as a **'strong will'** throughout the text.
 
• The author used various similes and phrases, such as "strong will is like a rushing torrent" and "iron will", continuously emphasizing the importance of a strong will.
 
• The passage mentions people who had achieved greatness through their "undaunted will."
 
• This focus on the power of determination and will is seen consistently throughout the passage, making **'strong will'** the main theme.

Therefore, the correct answer is*** "The main theme of the passage is a strong will. A person having a strong will can achieve anything in life."*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Undaunted Will (अविचलित इच्छा)** - Fearless determination that is not easily discouraged or subdued.

 
 
• **Example:** Despite the numerous challenges she faced, her undaunted will led her to success.
 
 
 
• **Rushing Torrent (तेज प्रवाह)** - A fast and strong flow, often used to describe a river or stream.
 
 
• **Example:** After the heavy rains, the calm river had turned into a rushing torrent.
